stops.name: Schaalsee
stops.quote: The 24 km² Schaalsee is the centre of the UNESCO biosphere reserve and gives it its name.
stops.english: The 24 km² Schaalsee is the centre of the UNESCO biosphere reserve and gives it its name.

stops.name: moors
stops.quote: Discover the 310 km² protected area between the metropolitan areas of Hamburg, Lübeck and Schwerin - characterised by moors and lakes, fields, pastures and wet meadows as well as beech forests.
